name: Iridescent (original)
desc: The original: iridescent compound-eye facets that twinkle, and a glowing pupil that looks around.

name: Force Nebula
desc: Swirling violet-blue nebula clouds turning around the pupil, with twinkling stars.

name: Sith Ember
desc: Smouldering red-orange: a glowing molten core, cracks that pulse, embers rising.

name: Hyperspace
desc: Star streaks rushing out from the pupil, blue-white.

name: Kyber Pulse
desc: Crystal facets lit by a heartbeat: double rings pulse out from the pupil.

name: Target Scanner
desc: Red targeting HUD: rotating reticle, a scan line sweeping, ticks round the rim.

name: Bioluminescent
desc: Deep-sea glow: soft spots drifting and pulsing in aqua and green.

name: Holo Glitch
desc: Blue hologram: scanlines rolling down, flicker, and glitches that slice the eye sideways.

name: Galaxy
desc: A spiral galaxy turning in each eye, gold core and blue-white arms.

name: Force Lightning
desc: Force lightning crackling across the eye in violet-white arcs.

name: Prism
desc: Holographic prism: rainbow rings and a rotating spectral fan.

name: Predator
desc: A predator's eye: gold iris with fibres and a slit pupil that narrows and widens as it looks around.
